phase: F0 — AI Console concept lock (16-gate sequence, mirrors Foundation Console gate model)

product_identity.doctrine: ZERO STATIC / ZERO LEGACY / ZERO FALLBACK / ZERO MIRROR / ZERO BROWSER NORMALIZATION / ZERO CONTAINERS — same as Foundation Console; AGENTS.md applies

subdomain_target.edge: Cloudflare published application route -> http://127.0.0.1:<AI_GATEWAY_PORT> (stage on build host) / new production host once F12-1 + F15 are gated
subdomain_target.module_subdomain_mounting_rule: AI = ai.shahin-ai.com (one of the reserved module subdomains: f/ri/co/as/wo/ai). No use of root shahin-ai.com or www.shahin-ai.com.

oidc_client.access_type: confidential or public (decided in F6 alongside gateway implementation; aligned with Foundation Console outcome)
operator_action_required_before_F14_5: Register Keycloak client 'ai-console' in realm 'dogan' (parallel to 'foundation-console')

db_runtime_namespace.rule: AI Console owns its own schemas. No reuse of fc_* schemas. No coupling to Foundation tables.
db_runtime_namespace.host_db: shahin_grc (shared host Postgres; namespace-isolated by schema, not by database — same pattern as Foundation Console)
db_runtime_namespace.migration_path: products/ai-console/db/migrations (to be created in F1/F2; idempotent forward + assertion at end)

consumed_dogan_ai_os_services.doctrine: AI Console consumes shared host services through its own gateway only. No direct browser → host service. No Foundation source coupling.

shared_host_services.consumed_by: ai-gateway only (server-side OIDC discovery + token exchange)
shared_host_services.browser_visibility: redirect endpoint only via 302 from ai-gateway

shared_host_services.purpose: DB persistence for ai_ui_os + ai_dynamic_ui schemas

ai_owned_services_to_be_built_in_F1: ai-gateway (Express/TypeScript; OIDC + reverse-proxy + static SPA serve; ports AI_GATEWAY_PORT)
ai-ui-os (workspace-runtime + page-runtime resolver; ai_ui_os schema only)
ai-dynamic-ui (Dynamic UI resolver; ai_dynamic_ui schema only)

ports_proposal_to_be_locked_in_F1.rule: Ports must not collide with Foundation Console (3000/3101/3102/4000) or any legacy DOS/Shahin service. Final values locked in F1 manifest.

env_contract_proposal_to_be_locked_in_F2.production_default_AI_DEV_TEST_SESSION_E: false (forced by systemd Environment line at F12)

16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F0: AI app concept lock — THIS DOCUMENT
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F2: Contracts/doctrine lock — manifest, runtime contracts (@ai/ui-contracts), env contract, AGENTS rules
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F3: DB-backed workspace runtime resolver (ai_ui_os) — empty runtime OK, no fallback
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F4: Shell V2 skeleton — renderer shell only
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F6: OIDC/cookie session — real DAuth/Keycloak flow, no browser tokens
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F8: DB seed for shell/nav/page rows — only approved mapped keys
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F9: DB-backed page runtime resolver — no static Angular pages
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F10: AI domain components — real AI components only; empty states explicit
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F11: Permission/session guard — DAuth permissions, no data leak
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F12: nginx/systemd stage wiring — no production cutover
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F14.5: Production-like UAT — HTTPS subdomain ai.shahin-ai.com, real DAuth, real DB/runtime
16_gate_sequence_for_ai_console.F15: Production cutover gate — only after all previous gates green AND Foundation Console F15 also green

hard_rules_acknowledged.separate_branch: feat/ai-console-init (created off feat/foundation-console-init @ 6829a0308 to inherit FC doctrine artifacts; no FC source code copied into AI tree)

do_not_start_until_F0_approved.no_oidc_client_registration_request_yet: Operator-owned; will be requested at F6/F14.5 boundary

scope_isolation_from_other_active_work.foundation_console_F12_1: untouched — separate branch (feat/foundation-console-init), separate proof dir (proofs/foundation-console/), separate runtime tree (products/foundation-console/)
scope_isolation_from_other_active_work.foundation_console_F15: still gated; AI Console F15 is independent and additionally gated on AI's own F0..F14.5
